message.content:
A medium-sized apple (about 182 g) typically contains around **95 calories**.  
- Small apples (≈150 g) have roughly 80–85 calories.  
- Large apples (≈250 g) can contain about 115–120 calories.

The exact calorie count varies slightly with the variety and ripeness, but most apples fall in the 80–120‑calorie range.
